scope: Theorem 8.5 (Random-sign patterns) of the manuscript “The free energy of the Ising random perceptron” (preprints/The-free-energy-of-the-Ising-random-perceptron-September-24-2026/The-free-energy-of-the-Ising-random-perceptron-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 222 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d848ece0b215a2b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Replace the Gaussian pattern entries by independent uniform signs in {−1, 1}. If f is bounded Borel and its discontinuity set has Gaussian measure zero, then its expected pressure and its pressure in probability converge to the same value Pf (α) as in Theorem 2.3. In particular, this holds for every bounded continuous activation.
